Understanding Vampire Face Lift

Not to be confused with the Vampire Facial, the Vampire Face Lift is a dual-action procedure that combines the structural benefits of hyaluronic acid dermal fillers with the regenerative properties of Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP). This provides an immediate lift while stimulating long-term tissue regeneration.

This treatment is designed for those who have experienced significant volume loss and skin aging, providing the immediate contouring of fillers with the skin-renewing magic of your own growth factors.

Key Benefits

  • Immediate volume restoration and facial lifting.
  • Long-term improvement in skin texture and tone.
  • Creates a beautiful, natural-looking facial contour.
  • Stimulates new blood vessel formation for a rosy glow.

Suitable Candidates

Perfect for individuals experiencing sagging skin, volume loss in the cheeks or under the eyes, and dull skin tone who want comprehensive, non-surgical facial rejuvenation.

Who Should Avoid

  • Pregnant or nursing women.
  • Those with active facial infections or severe autoimmune conditions.

The Treatment Journey

1. Step-by-Step Procedure

  1. Blood Draw & Spin: PRP is extracted and prepared.
  2. Filler Injection: Dermal fillers are injected to create a scaffold and restore volume.
  3. PRP Injection: PRP is then injected into the face to stimulate stem cells and tissue regeneration.

Recovery

Mild swelling and bruising are common for 3 to 7 days.

Results

Immediate lifting from the fillers. The PRP benefits (improved skin quality and additional volume from new collagen) develop over 2 to 3 months.

Maintenance

Results can last 12 to 18 months. Annual touch-ups are recommended.

Risks

Bruising, swelling, asymmetry, and standard filler risks (such as vascular occlusion, though rare).

Aftercare

  • Avoid strenuous exercise for 48 hours.
  • Do not massage or apply pressure to the face.
  • Sleep elevated to reduce swelling.
